lab0_phone.label: Crash · distraction
lab0_phone.state: Unit 1 northbound in light rain, left lane. Driver states she looked down at her phone for directions, looked up, and traffic had stopped. Unit 1 struck the rear of Unit 2. No injuries reported.

questions.instructions: Was the driver of Unit 1 distracted?
Did weather contribute to the crash?

lab1_scaffold.label: Construction · scaffold
lab1_scaffold.state: Worker on level 3 scaffold. East guardrail missing. Worker slipped, harness held, no injury.

questions.instructions: Does the report describe a fall hazard?
Did fall protection stop the fall?

lab2_schema.label: Crash · schema
lab2_schema.state: Unit 2 was stopped at the light on FM 1626. Driver of Unit 1 stated he felt dizzy and blacked out before the crash. Witness stated Unit 1 did not brake. Driver of Unit 1 transported to hospital by EMS.

questions.instructions: The narrative states that a driver had a medical episode, such as fainting, a seizure, or a diabetic event, before or during the crash.
What kind of medical episode does the narrative describe?

criteria.loss_of_consciousness: Fainting, blacking out, or passing out.

questions.instructions: The narrative cites a statement from a witness.

lab4_table_vs_narrative.label: Crash · two readers
lab4_table_vs_narrative.state: Unit 1 was traveling west on Loop 410 in moderate traffic. Driver of Unit 1 stated he was reading a text message when traffic slowed ahead. Unit 1 struck the rear of Unit 2. Driver of Unit 2 complained of neck pain.

questions.instructions: The narrative states that a driver was using a phone, such as talking, texting, or reading, at the time of the crash.
The narrative states that a person was injured or complained of pain.

lab6_construction.label: Construction · trench
lab6_construction.state: Excavation at Pier 3 is about 8 feet deep with no shoring or trench box. Laborer entered the trench to clear a pump hose. Spoil pile placed at the trench edge. Foreman stopped work and cleared the trench.

questions.instructions: Does the report describe a trench cave-in hazard?

lab6_bridge.label: Bridge · inspection
lab6_bridge.state: Span 2, girder G3. Diagonal crack about 0.5 mm wide near the east bearing. Rust staining below the deck joint. No section loss observed. Bearing appears frozen.

questions.instructions: Does the note describe a defect that needs an engineer's site visit before the next routine inspection?
How severe is the worst defect described?

criteria.minor: Cosmetic or minor, no action needed before the next routine cycle.
criteria.severe: Threatens load capacity or safety and needs prompt action.

lab6_water.label: Water · main break
lab6_water.state: Customers on Elm Street report low pressure and brown water since 6 AM. Crew found a 12-inch cast iron main break near hydrant 44. Roadway surface is undermined and sagging in the eastbound lane.

questions.instructions: Does the report describe a hazard to traffic on the roadway?
Is the broken pipe made of cast iron?

lab6_fire.label: Building · fire
lab6_fire.state: Fire started in a second-floor kitchen of a four-story apartment building. Corridor smoke detectors activated. The building has no sprinkler system. Occupants evacuated by stairwell B. One resident treated for smoke inhalation.

questions.instructions: Was a fire suppression system missing or did it fail?
